title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
verified_main_method: selective triggering of action-sampling/verification with learned action scoring
novelty_threat: Action-level selective verification already exists
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Compare selection overhead and trained verifier; U-CODE needs distinct heterogeneous test/retrieve/analyze/repair decisions, explicit accept/abstain and empirically validated risk

title: GA4GC: Greener Agent for Greener Code via Multi-Objective Configuration Optimization
verified_main_method: offline multiobjective search over coding-agent hyperparameters and prompts
novelty_threat: Multiobjective optimization of agents is already established
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Distinguish online intervention policy from offline configuration tuning; add GA4GC-style objective and Pareto baseline

title: SWE-Search: Enhancing Software Agents with Monte Carlo Tree Search and Iterative Refinement
verified_main_method: MCTS plus value/discriminator agents for repository repair
novelty_threat: Search among agent trajectories is not novel per se
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Compare budget-matched MCTS/search-without-calibration against evidence-acquisition selection

title: SWE-Replay: Efficient Test-Time Scaling for Software Engineering Agents
verified_main_method: reuses trajectories and branches from useful intermediate states without noisy value estimates
novelty_threat: Calibrated-value claims must withstand score-free replay baselines
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Compare cost at equal budgets; test failure under calibration shift

title: When Uncertainty Isn't Enough: An Empirical Study of Self-Correction in Code Generation
verified_main_method: examines uncertainty versus execution-based self-correction in small coding models
novelty_threat: Uncertainty-only regeneration can degrade accuracy
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Make uncertainty-only a negative-control arm and prioritize test evidence value

title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation
verified_main_method: program/token confidence often fails to discriminate incorrect programs
novelty_threat: Model confidence may not be a robust correctness proxy
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Measure false acceptance and OOD uncertainty calibration not just ECE

title: Rethinking the Value of Agent-Generated Tests for LLM-Based Software Engineering Agents
verified_main_method: agent-written test frequency may fail to improve resolution
novelty_threat: More testing is not necessarily better
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Compare independently qualified diagnostic tests vs naive test-count policy

title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
verified_main_method: separate test and repair agents with qualified/frozen tests
novelty_threat: Testing source and gold-reference leakage are critical
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Require independent sealed verifier and include qualified test-first baseline

title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
verified_main_method: trains agent on diverse repair exploration and verification quality
novelty_threat: Another strong verifier and diverse-search competitor
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Distinguish inference-time allocation without training; measure reliability of tests

title: GTDD: Generative Test-Driven Development for AI Coding Agents with Adversarial Testing
verified_main_method: generates diagnostic tests after candidate commit using trusted evaluator
novelty_threat: Adaptive test generation and trusted verification already explored
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: U-CODE to study when to purchase this action under budget, not claim invention of testing

title: Thinking Longer, Not Larger: Enhancing Software Engineering Agents via Scaling Test-Time Compute
verified_main_method: process-guided search with reward model and execution verification
novelty_threat: Inference allocation at agent decision points not new
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Compare against cost-matched reward-guided search and verify value of calibrated intervention models

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding
verified_main_method: parallel and sequential trajectory reuse/selection
novelty_threat: Search effort and evidence reuse can improve coding
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Include comparable search/reuse option and avoid describing mere adaptive compute as new

title: Cost-effective Agent Test-Time Scaling
verified_main_method: budget-aware allocation between sequential and parallel tool-augmented exploration
novelty_threat: Dual token/tool costs are known problem
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Require multi-resource cost accounting; compare against budget-aware controller

title: AdaDec: Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Decoding for LLM-based Code Generation
verified_main_method: token-uncertainty-triggered lookahead reranking
novelty_threat: Uncertainty-directed code decisions exist at token granularity
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Emphasize post-generation repository interventions; token adaptation comparator when viable

title: FormulaCode: Evaluating Agentic Optimization on Large Codebases
verified_main_method: benchmark of repository-scale multiobjective performance optimization
novelty_threat: Existing multiobjective code benchmarks compete with our dataset story
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Report runtime/resource objectives and independent correctness not invented dataset novelty

title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale
verified_main_method: large multilingual executable repository issue corpus
novelty_threat: Do not claim to invent multilingual executable tasks
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Use as controlled task cohort and verify labels/oracles

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-world Github Issues?
verified_main_method: real-world GitHub issue/PR evaluation with executable tests
novelty_threat: Standard patch-resolution methodology
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Preserve pre-fix tasks, independent oracles and held-out status

title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
verified_main_method: agent-computer interface enables terminal/edit/test loops
novelty_threat: Basic test/edit/repair agent architecture is established
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Use comparable harness; novel question is evidence/cost/risk policy

title: CodeT: Code Generation with Generated Tests
verified_main_method: generated tests and candidate execution agreement
novelty_threat: Tester-assisted code selection predates U-CODE
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Distinguish candidate-test selection from action-level cost allocation and licensed repository tasks

title: Conformal Risk Control
verified_main_method: statistical risk control using held-out calibration and monotone losses
novelty_threat: A risk threshold alone does not confer coverage/risk guarantees
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: If making guarantees, calibrate final adaptive policy end-to-end under explicit assumptions

title: SAFER: Risk-Constrained Sample-then-Filter in Large Language Models
verified_main_method: abstention and conformal risk control in language-model sample/filter workflows
novelty_threat: Formal selective risk is an existing paradigm
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: New result requires SE domain adaptation and costs; report conditional accepted error with valid inference

title: Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents
verified_main_method: coding-agent memory retrieval/abstention via risk-sensitive contextual bandit
novelty_threat: Uncertainty-aware retrieval and abstention alone not novel
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Differentiate all-intervention allocation with independent executable correctness; acknowledge contextual bandit baseline

title: Conformal Risk Control under Distribution Shift
verified_main_method: risk control under nonexchangeable data with weights
novelty_threat: Risk certification during repo/language drift is not automatic
required_ucode_distinction_or_baseline: Report no distribution-free claim under shift absent assumptions and validation
